subject: Named Entity Recognition
object: identify and classify entity mentions from unstructured text
source_sentence: Named Entity Recognition (NER) aims to identify and classify entity mentions from unstructured text, e.g., extracting location mention "Berlin" from the sentence "Berlin is wonderful in the winter".
title: MINER: Improving Out-of-Vocabulary Named Entity Recognition from an Information Theoretic Perspective

subject: NER Models
object: state-of-the-art results on several public benchmarks
source_sentence: Benefiting from the development of deep learning, neural- network-based NER models have achieved state- of-the-art results on several public benchmarks (Lample et al., 2016; Peters et al., 2018; Devlin et al., 2018; Yamada et al., 2020; Yan et al., 2021).
title: MINER: Improving Out-of-Vocabulary Named Entity Recognition from an Information Theoretic Perspective
